study_design: Prospective EPIC cohort analysis with cancer-occurrence follow-up.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Data on food consumption and complete follow-up for cancer occurrence was available for 139,005 men, recruited in 8 European countries.
reason: The abstract reports first incident prostate cancer overall but does not analyze high-grade, advanced, metastatic, lethal, or another aggressive incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There was no overall association between prostate cancer risk and nitrosamines exposure (preformed and endogenous) or heme iron intake (HR for a doubling of intake: 1.00; 95% CI: 0.98-1.03 for N-Nitrosodimethlyamine, 0.95; 95% CI: 0.88-1.03 for endogenous Nitrosocompounds, and 1.00; 95 CI: 0.97-1.03 for heme iron).
estimate_classifications.reason: The heme iron estimate is explicitly for overall prostate cancer risk, with no aggressive disease analysis established by the abstract.
